name: IFWF Weekend Warfare

date.source: The card's own results post (17 March 1996): 'these are the results of the very first IFWF card, Weekend Warfare for March 16th 1996.'

no_appearances_reason: The card crowned an IFWF Heavyweight Champion across a multi-round tournament; none of the entrants (including the eventual finalists) are minted as characters.json records, so no appearances/matches are structured -- the bracket and its bouts live in the served page's own text.
notes: The Internet Fantasy Wrestling Federation's own inaugural card, explicitly self-declared 'a sub-federation of the GWF Global Wrestling Federation' and citing the same geocities.com/Colosseum/3311 address already on file for this wing. The full card ran across five further posts (17-24 March 1996) carrying the tournament's second round, semi-finals and a steel-cage final; held collected, not served or structured, this pass.
